paper_metadata.title: Synthesis of stochastic open cell Ni-based foams

evidence.quote: transient liquid phase bonding nickel based superalloy (Ni–21Cr–9Mo–4Nb)
and Ni–25Cr–10P powders
An Inconel® alloy 625 nickel-based superalloy of nominal composition: Ni–21.3Cr–8.8Mo–3.9Nb–0.13Al–0.19Ti, wt.% was chosen as the base alloy.
The base alloy powder was sieved to a −60 mesh size which corresponds to a particle size of less than 250 lm.
A NICROBRAZ® alloy 51 powder with a nominal composition of Ni–25.0Cr–10.0P–0.03C, wt.% used as the transient liquid phase sintering agent.
The particle size was less than 100 lm.

samples.original_name: transient liquid phase sintered Ni–21Cr–9Mo–4Nb open cell, stochastic foam (braze:base = 1:9)

evidence.quote: transient liquid phase bonding nickel based superalloy (Ni–21Cr–9Mo–4Nb) and Ni–25Cr–10P powders

Here, a braze:base powder ratio of 1:9 was used.
Table 1 summarizes the mechanical properties of the transient liquid phase sintered Ni–21Cr–9Mo–4Nb open cell, stochastic foams
The base alloy powder was sieved to a −60 mesh size which corresponds to a particle size of less than 250 lm.
The particle size was less than 100 lm.
30 · 30 · 15 mm3 carbon foam templates were dipped in a binder solution (NICROBRAZ® 520 cement) and lightly shaken to remove excess binder.
The binder-coated foams were then suspended in a fluidized airbed containing a mixture of base alloy and braze powder.
The powder coated carbon foams were dried and placed in a vacuum furnace (10−4 Torr)
heated at a rate of 10 °C/min up to 550 °C, holding for 1 h (to volatilize the binder)

process_steps.output_state: transient liquid phase sintered Ni-based foam

evidence.quote: then continued heating to 1050 °C, held for 2 h followed by furnace cooling at ~25 °C/min. The transient liquid phase sintering agent has a brazing temperature range of 980–1095 °C.
It is a non age-hardenable, solid solution strengthened alloy with a face centered cubic (c-phase) crystal structure.
The resultant metal foams consisted of an open cell, stochastic carbon core uniformly coated by the variable density nickel alloy, Fig. 1.

attributes.size: 5–10 times the thickness of the carbon core
attributes.morphology: nearly fully dense with rough surface

evidence.quote: This resulted in a nearly fully dense metal coating with a rough surface. The thickness of the metal layer was ~5–10 times the thickness of the carbon core.
The cell size of the carbon foams were measured according to ASTM D3576-98 and the average cell diameter was determined to be ~3.55 mm with a standard deviation of 0.324.

mechanisms.name: capillary action of transient liquid phase

evidence.quote: During initial heating of transient liquid phase sintering, the liquid initially formed, due to its lower melting point, begins to spread through capillary action.
It is a non age-hardenable, solid solution strengthened alloy with a face centered cubic (c-phase) crystal structure.
